annotations.title: Company search (offline here; indexed search is live elsewhere)

description:
Indexed Jobs search is LIVE (paid, on your own Apify token): one call searches 8,800+ Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever company boards, with radius and salary filters, from a fresh daily index (not a live scrape of a few boards). Run it as the Apify Actor https://apify.com/fairquery/jobs-index-search or the MCP https://mcp.getfairquery.com/jobs-index/mcp (send your Apify token). New Apify accounts get a $5 starter credit. This free tool stays free and live-scans the 135-board starter list.
WHAT: Offline on this free server. Paid indexed Jobs search is live elsewhere: the Apify Actor https://apify.com/fairquery/jobs-index-search or the MCP https://mcp.getfairquery.com/jobs-index/mcp, on your own Apify token. One call searches 8,800+ Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever boards with radius and salary filters from a fresh daily index. This tool does not run any Actor.
WHEN: Do not call this for jobs. For many companies, radius or salary filters, point the user to the Actor or MCP above (Apify token from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations; new accounts get a $5 starter credit). For free jobs by place or role, call jobs_search_by_location (135 starter boards, no token).
WHEN NOT: Any live lookup. One board (jobs_get_board). A place or role on the starter list (jobs_search_by_location — call that; do not ask for a company). One job's full detail (jobs_get_job), or one open/closed re-check (jobs_check_open).
BEHAVIOR: Returns COMING_SOON immediately on this Fairquery-hosted Worker. Does not read an Apify token from the request, does not call Apify, and does not start an Actor run, whether or not a token is sent. Arguments are ignored. Nothing is billed. Free tools keep working with no token.
COST: Not billed. No Actor run. Indexed search bills the caller's own Apify account on the Actor or MCP above, never through this free server.
RETURNS: Tool error COMING_SOON (retryable false, kept as the error code) and no job rows. The message says indexed search is live, links the Actor and MCP, and suggests jobs_search_by_location for free.
PARAMETERS: Accepted and ignored while this tool is offline. companies, boards, useSeedList, filters, onlyNew, stateStoreName, confirmOpen, includeDescription and maxJobs do not start a run. An empty call also returns COMING_SOON (not INPUT_EMPTY).
EXAMPLE: {"companies":["stripe.com"]} -> COMING_SOON with links to indexed search, not billed. Free: {"locations":["Tampa"],"descriptionIncludes":["engineer"]} on jobs_search_by_location.

ats.description: Required. The applicant-tracking system hosting the board: "greenhouse" | "lever" | "ashby" | "personio" | "pinpoint" | "gem". Personio, Pinpoint and Gem are the account, subdomain or vanity you name, not a discovered board. Example: "ashby"

slug.description: Required. Board slug as it appears in the public board URL (case-insensitive): boards.greenhouse.io/{slug}, jobs.lever.co/{slug}, jobs.ashbyhq.com/{slug}, the Personio account in {account}.jobs.personio.de, the Pinpoint subdomain in {subdomain}.pinpointhq.com, or the Gem vanity in jobs.gem.com/{vanity}. Named feeds reject a dot. 1-100 chars. Example: "ramp" or "acme"

companies.description: Optional (see PARAMETERS). 0-200 names, domains or board URLs. Example: ["stripe.com","Ramp","https://jobs.lever.co/palantir"]

confirmOpen.description: Ignored while this tool is temporarily offline (not billed). Previously re-checked each emitted job on its detail endpoint.

departments.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Department/team substring match. Example: ["engineering"]

excludeStale.description: Optional boolean, default false. true drops job rows with long_open = true (age_days > 60, counted from posted_at, or from first_seen_at when the ATS gives no date) or reposted = true (a new job id matching a job that closed on the same board within 90 days, from the history in stateStoreName, so never on a board's first tracked run). Free closed rows are not filtered by it

includeDescription.description: Optional boolean, default false: add plain-text descriptions (PII-scrubbed)

locations.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Location substring match. US state names and codes match both ways; NYC, SF, LA, DC and Tampa Bay metro aliases match. Example: ["london"]

maxJobs.description: Ignored while this tool is temporarily offline (not billed). Previously a cap on job rows (integer 1-50000, default 5000).

offset.description: Optional items to skip, integer >= 0, default 0; pass nextOffset from the previous response

onlyNew.description: Optional boolean, default false: only new/changed jobs since the last tracked run (plus free closed rows)

postedWithinDays.description: Optional integer 1-3650, default off: keep only job rows whose ATS publish date (posted_at) is at most this many whole days old; rows without an ATS publish date (posted_at = null) are dropped. Free closed rows are not filtered by it. Example: 7

remote.description: Optional, "any" | "only" | "exclude", default "any" (no remote filter). "only" keeps job rows with remote = true (an ATS remote flag, or remote wording such as "Remote" or "Anywhere" in the location or title; see remote_basis); "exclude" drops those rows and keeps rows where remote is false or unknown (null)

stateStoreName.description: Optional, default "fairquery-jobs-feed-state": named key-value store for history in your Apify account

titleExcludes.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Whole-word title exclusion. Example: ["intern"]

titleIncludes.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Whole-word title match. Example: ["engineer"]

useSeedList.description: Ignored while this tool is temporarily offline (not billed). Previously: also scan the verified starter boards.

name: jobs_search_companies

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

items.description: Result rows. Each has "type": "job" (job_key, title, company, locations, countries, remote, posted_at, verified_open_at, age_days, long_open, apply_url, source_url, ...), "board", "company", "seed_board", "open_check" or "error" (code, message, retryable)

meta.description: Tool-specific context: board totals, request counts, cost notes

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when done

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

total.description: Total items after filters, before paging
